richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhilwara

c: Bhilwara is one of India's main textile towns, and its spinning and weaving units employ large numbers of workers across shifts. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhilwara to factory campuses, staff colonies, schools, colleges and municipal gardens in Mewar. The Fun Fitness machines are built at our Vasai factory, about 690 km away, and sent to Rajasthan by road.

A factory gym in a textile town has to suit people who stand at machines all day and have little time before or after a shift. Simple, low-impact equipment gets used more than heavy strength stations. The weather is dry and hot for much of the year, with dust in the summer wind and short, intense rain in the monsoon. We build frames from galvanised pipe and seats from roto-moulded plastic, and we fix each machine by grouting or self-standing installation, depending on the ground.

items.q: Can a textile unit in Bhilwara set up an open gym for its workers?
items.a: Yes. Tell us the space available and how many workers are on each shift. We will suggest machines that suit tired users and send a layout drawing for approval.

items.q: How do we keep dust out of the moving parts?
items.a: The bearings are housed, so most dust stays out. Wipe the seats and handles daily in summer and ask a staff member to check for loose bolts once a month.

items.q: Do the machines need electricity or a trainer?
items.a: No electricity is needed. Each machine uses the person's own body weight. A simple instruction board next to each station is enough for first-time users.
